channel.title: Yaprflow Updates
channel.description: Signed updates for Yaprflow for Mac.

item.description:
# Yaprflow 5.2.8
This maintenance release makes AI-generated meeting outputs more reliable:
- Action plans and meeting summaries now recover cleanly when an AI provider returns truncated or slightly malformed structured output. - Structured output is rendered as native Yaprflow sections instead of exposing raw JSON in the meeting view. - Existing saved meetings containing a raw structured response are repaired automatically when they are reopened. - Unrecoverable structured output now produces a clear retry state rather than being displayed as meeting content.
Quick Dictation and the meeting transcription workflow are unchanged.
